tasks.migration: New tables only; migration preserves users/progress. Retain old anchors after content update with explicit moved/unavailable state, no silent reassignment to wrong lesson. Rollback disables UI/API flag without deleting notes.
tests: Search finds supplied Arabic/English text and never leaks hidden course snippets/counts.
Student B cannot read/edit/export A notes; stale edit returns conflict.
Bookmark seek/version change/retraction, retry and bilingual keyboard browser workflow pass.

Personal annotations survive course revisions and export.

tasks.title: Provide deterministic mastery and revision practice
tasks.target: Outcome mastery and revision queues are explainable rules over final assessment evidence, never AI recommendations or watch-time claims.
steps: Backend: version mastery rules with explicit evidence weights/thresholds and deterministic due-date spacing; only finalized eligible question grades count.
Frontend: show outcome evidence, rule version, weak topics and next teacher-provided practice; distinguish incomplete/pending from zero mastery.
Database: OutcomeEvidence keyed by attempt/question/gradeVersion and MasterySnapshot/ruleVersion; preserve historic snapshots and support replay after regrade.
Configuration/infrastructure: staged gate, outbox-driven recalculation and reconciliation, educator validates thresholds and exercise mapping before enablement.
tasks.example: Mastery={"outcomeId":"lo_1","ruleVersion":1,"state":"DEVELOPING","evidenceCount":3,"score":0.6,"nextRevisionAt":"..."}; published rule v1 requires >=3 finalized questions and mean normalized score >=0.8 for MASTERED.
tasks.controls: Student sees own records only; reviewer/admin sees permitted aggregate. Regrade removes old evidence by gradeVersion and recomputes idempotently. Videos watched never imply concept mastered; no fabricated predictions.
tasks.migration: Backfill only reliable finalized grades with mapped outcomes; unknown legacy evidence excluded explicitly. Rule changes generate new snapshot versions, do not rewrite original grades. Rollback selects previous rule snapshot.
tests: Same evidence yields same score/queue, pending essays excluded and regrade replay updates once.
No access to another student or unavailable practice; missing outcome gives INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
Arabic/English explanation, clock boundary and parallel recalculation/retry remain deterministic.
done: Educator signs off rule examples and educational limitations.
M4 launch flag enabled only after deterministic replay tests.

tasks.title: Deliver durable notifications and communication preferences
tasks.target: In-app/email notifications survive restarts with scoped recipient dedupe, retry visibility and communication preferences.
steps: Backend: notification consumer for announcement/grade/review/payment/security events; distinguish mandatory security/transactional from optional study/marketing messages.
Frontend: paginated inbox, unread count/read-owned action, per-channel preferences and localized templates/status.
Database: Notification unique(eventId,recipientId,channel), DeliveryAttempt and CommunicationPreference; outbox links and retry scheduling.
Configuration/infrastructure: Postgres outbox plus Redis/BullMQ delivery transport, provider timeouts, max attempts/dead-letter/replay and operator queue; no memory fallback success.
tasks.example: PATCH /api/v1/me/communication-preferences {"studyEmail":false,"announcementEmail":true}; read action POST /notifications/n_1/read; enqueue returns QUEUED, not delivered.
tasks.controls: Recipients resolved from effective policy and deduped. Recheck permission for sensitive deep links; notification body contains minimal data and no answer keys/live host links. Channel preference cannot disable essential account-security notification policy.
tasks.migration: Preserve existing notifications/read flags and derive stable legacy dedupe IDs. Do not resend old announcements automatically. Rollback pauses delivery queue, retains attempts/events for safe resume.
tests: Worker crash/provider timeout/duplicate event delivers at most one logical inbox item and records retries.
Student B cannot mark/read A message; opted-out optional email not sent; transactional policy explicit.
Arabic/English templates/links/inbox and concurrent read/unread requests preserve state.
done: Durable queue/outbox restart and dead-letter recovery demonstrated.
A30 notification recipient/delivery evidence replaces best-effort sends.

tasks.title: Establish minor consent now and stage a guardian portal
tasks.target: Launch onboarding has a reviewed age/consent and data-minimization policy. A separately scoped guardian portal is M4 and remains disabled until implemented.
steps: Backend launch: implement age-band/consent requirements approved by qualified local policy review; version consent text, responsible adult attestation where required and refusal/revocation path; make current studentNumber school/national identifier optional by default unless a documented necessary approved purpose requires it.
Frontend launch: Arabic/English plain-language student/guardian notices and support process; remove unnecessary required school/national identifier inputs.

Database: ConsentRecord(user,policyVersion,purpose,actor,proofReference,status,timestamps) with restricted access; avoid storing full birthdate if age band suffices and preserve/restrict existing identifiers pending retention review.
Configuration/infrastructure launch: gate real-minor pilot on policy approval, consent evidence, retention and incident support; no legal-compliance claim from code alone.
M4 portal: add scoped guardian role/link invitation, verified linkage approval/revocation, limited progress summaries and read-only access, never shared student credentials or answer/note access.
tasks.example: POST /api/v1/consents {"policyVersion":"pv_1","purpose":"STUDENT_LEARNING","decision":"ACCEPT","attestationId":"..."}; POST /guardian/links -> 503 FEATURE_DISABLED at launch.
tasks.controls: Policy decisions on age thresholds/legal basis require owner and qualified local review before real-minor onboarding; do not hardcode guessed law. Portal link must be verified and scoped per child; unlink takes effect on next access, parent role never grants teacher/admin authority.
tasks.migration: Inventory existing minors/consent evidence; unknown consent is not backfilled accepted. Stage re-consent without deleting coursework and offer support/export. Rollback disables onboarding/portal for affected scope, preserves consent evidence securely.
tests: Launch required consent refusal/missing/withdrawn blocks dependent processing appropriately; data minimization checked.
M4 unverified guardian cannot claim arbitrary student; revoked link loses access and never exposes private notes/submission content beyond approved scope.
Arabic/English notice comprehension, concurrent link revoke/read, age transition and support workflow pass.
done: M3 minimal consent policy/evidence is approved before minor pilot.
M4 guardian portal stays API-disabled until independent acceptance passes.

tasks.title: Issue auditable certificates with privacy-safe verification
tasks.target: Certificates reflect explicit human-approved completion criteria, immutable issue evidence and revocable public verification.
steps: Backend: define versioned completion criterion and idempotent issuance after finalized required learning/assessment; verification uses opaque unguessable code.
Frontend: student download with bilingual template and privacy-safe public verification showing only approved minimal fields.
Database: Certificate unique(user,course,criteriaVersion), evidence snapshot, verificationCodeHash, revokedAt/reason and generated artifact asset ID.
Configuration/infrastructure: staged gate, deterministic document renderer for supplied data, protected certificate storage and authorized operator revoke/reissue.
tasks.example: GET /api/v1/certificates/verify/<opaque-code> -> {"data":{"valid":true,"courseTitle":{"ar":"..."},"issuedAt":"...","displayName":"<consented minimal name>"}}; no email/student ID.
tasks.controls: Only own downloads, public verify rate-limited; no claim of Ministry accreditation. Issuance retries create one certificate. Regrade/correction policy explicit; revoked certificates never become valid through stale cache.
tasks.migration: No automatic certificates for uncertain legacy completion; backfill only verified criteria evidence with owner approval. Preserve issued snapshots/void history, rollback disables issuing but keeps verification/revocation available.
tests: Pending grades/incomplete work cannot issue; qualifying student gets one certificate under parallel requests.
Verification code guessing/rate limit and cross-account download denied; revoke visible immediately at authority.
Arabic/English PDF/font layout, names, accessibility and browser download verified.
done: Staged criteria and issuance/verification/revocation tests pass.
Public verification exposes only consented minimal data.

tasks.title: Offer rights-controlled expiring offline study packs
tasks.target: Authorized students may cache explicitly licensed published study content with bounded lease, quotas and clear limits on offline revocation.
steps: Backend: pack manifest pins course revision/assets, rights policy, user/device scope and lease end=min(access end, issue+24h) by default; never include keys/host links or unsafe assessments.
Frontend: service worker/IndexedDB pack manager, storage estimate, download/cancel/delete, expiry/revalidate and accessible offline state.
Database: OfflineLease/PackManifest version plus device quota and delivery audit; store no reusable provider service credentials.

Configuration/infrastructure: staged gate and explicit rights opt-in; sign manifests, protect content transit, handle lost device and revoke at next online check; explain that downloaded bytes cannot be reliably recalled.
tasks.example: POST /api/v1/offline/packs {"courseId":"c_1","revisionId":"r_1","lessonIds":["l_1"]} -> {"data":{"manifestId":"op_1","expiresAt":"...","requiresOnlineRenewal":true}}.
tasks.controls: No promise of perfect DRM. Server grants bounded lease only after current access/rights check; cached assessment grading keys excluded. Logout/account switch clears accessible cache namespace; revoked/retracted pack blocked on next online validation and expiry enforced locally within stated limits.
tasks.migration: New tables/cache only; no migration of old private URLs into permanent public files. Preserve server progress and reconcile bounded queued study events through LRN-12. Rollback stops issuance and offers delete/revalidate, keeps lease audit.
tests: No-rights/expired/nonmember requests denied; pack excludes keys and private unrelated assets.
Interrupted download/resume, quota full, corrupted manifest, offline expiry and online retraction correct.
Arabic/English low-connectivity Android/iOS study, account switch/cache cleanup and sync retry pass.
done: M4 rights/security review accepts stated offline limits.
No permanent public URL or unbounded entitlement is created.

tasks.title: Implement scoped realtime collaborative whiteboards
tasks.target: A real shared board uses block/revision identity, authorized session membership, explicit capabilities and deterministic conflict resolution.
steps: Backend: separate realtime gateway with short-lived board-scoped tickets issued by API policy; roles VIEW/DRAW/MODERATE and teacher-controlled session roster.
Frontend: real block ID, CRDT operation stream, presence, pointer/touch scaling, undo scope and reconnect state; no manual-save claim as realtime.
Database: BoardSession(scope,owner,revision), durable snapshots/op sequence/idempotency and retention; Redis pubsub only transport, not sole persistence.
Configuration/infrastructure: isolated websocket deployment, bounded ops/bytes/connections, heartbeat/revocation and snapshot recovery; staged off until multi-instance/restart tests pass.
tasks.example: POST /api/v1/boards/b_1/sessions -> {"data":{"sessionId":"bs_1","ticket":"<short-lived>","capabilities":["VIEW","DRAW"],"expiresAt":"..."}}; op {"clientId":"d_1","seq":7,"type":"stroke",...}.
tasks.controls: Board membership never inferred from teacher/student role alone; source course access and session assignment required. Revoke tickets/sockets on expiry/retraction; repeated ops deduped, malformed payload bounded, no cross-board joins.
tasks.migration: Map existing static drawings as initial snapshots with owner provenance; do not merge unrelated demo boards. Preserve IDs and export capability. Rollback disables new sessions, saves snapshots and keeps read-only operator recovery.
tests: Two browsers draw simultaneously and converge after disconnect/reorder/duplicate ops.
Student cannot save/view unrelated board, exceed DRAW capability or reuse revoked ticket.
Worker/gateway restart/multi-instance convergence, touch scaling, Arabic/English labels and keyboard alternative pass.
done: M4 concurrency/security/accessibility evidence permits flag enablement.
No demo ID fallback or process-memory-only drawing durability remains.

tasks.title: Move untrusted code to a separate isolated executor
tasks.target: Untrusted code executes only in a disposable isolated runtime without API/database/storage secrets, with resource and egress enforcement.
steps: Backend: API validates exercise/access/language and enqueues bounded job; executor adapter accepts only signed internal job IDs and returns sanitized result.
Frontend: queued/running/timeout/cancel/result states and bounded stdout/stderr; no HTML execution of output.
Database: ExecutionJob(owner,exerciseVersion,language,status,limits,idempotencyKey) and result metadata; preserve source only under explicit retention policy.

Configuration/infrastructure: dedicated worker host/microVM or reviewed container isolation with nonroot/read-only base, ephemeral workdir, dropped capabilities, seccomp, no host socket/mounts, deny network, CPU/memory/PID/time/output quotas and full process-tree kill.
Security: pinned runtime images, artifact scanning, tenant isolation/no shared writable cache, independent credentials/queue scope and penetration/resource-exhaustion review before enabling.
tasks.example: POST /api/v1/executions {"exerciseVersionId":"ev_1","language":"python","source":"print(1)","clientJobId":"job_1"} -> 202 job; default limits 2s CPU, 5s wall, 128MiB memory, 16 processes, 64KiB output; unsupported languages rejected.
tasks.controls: No app-host subprocess path may remain as fallback. Access checked at enqueue/start/result; quotas per user/global. Jobs idempotent per actor/intent, cancel/timeout terminal and descendants killed. Executor cannot reach PG, metadata services or public internet.
tasks.migration: Preserve saved exercises as inert data, no replay of old submissions automatically. Rollback server flag off, stop admission, terminate running jobs, retain result/audit metadata and destroy ephemeral environments.
tests: Filesystem escape/network/metadata/fork/memory/output/time adversarial fixtures contained with no API secret access.
Cross-account job/result, duplicate enqueue and cancel/finish race correct; dead worker recovery cannot rerun side effects outside sandbox.
Arabic/English queued/error/output UI, resource alerts and clean environment destruction verified.
done: Independent isolation review and operational kill-switch drill pass before enablement.
General API/CI processes never execute untrusted source.

tasks.title: Provide support and operational privacy/retention workflows
tasks.target: Students/teachers have human support and controlled data export/deletion; retention rules preserve necessary payment/audit evidence without indefinite unnecessary student data.
steps: Backend: support tickets with scoped attachments, privacy request identity verification, asynchronous export and deletion/anonymization plans with legal-hold exceptions.
Frontend: bilingual help/report/payment escalation, request status, downloadable private expiring export and explicit deletion consequences.
Database: SupportTicket/PrivacyRequest/RetentionPolicy/LegalHold and execution audit; separate educational drafts/submissions/notes/receipts/financial/audit retention classes.

Configuration/infrastructure: product/qualified local review approves retention durations/legal basis before real onboarding; scheduled dry-run deletion, job retries, backup expiry and incident response access process.
Operations: publish support hours/SLA/escalation and payment/refund/retraction procedures; test restore without resurrecting already-deleted data by replaying deletion ledger.
tasks.example: POST /api/v1/me/privacy-requests {"type":"EXPORT"} -> 202 requestId; DELETE request has verification/reasoned retained categories; export delivered as private asset grant to verified owner only.
tasks.controls: Do not promise blanket erasure of legally retained payment evidence. Owner verification and recent auth before export/delete; support staff least privilege and actual actor audit. Jobs idempotent per request/item, failure visible and retryable, no partial false completion.
tasks.migration: Inventory existing personal data/storage/backups and ownership first. Approved retention version drives dry run, review, then execution; preserve evidence of actions with minimal identifiers. Rollback cannot restore deleted private data into active use without honoring deletion ledger.
tests: Student B/support without scope cannot obtain A export/receipts; expired export denied.
Delete/export concurrent activity, job crash/retry/legal hold and backup restore honor exact request state.
Arabic/English ticket/privacy flow, support escalation for failed payment and documented retention review pass.
done: M3 policy values and human support ownership approved before pilot.
Export/deletion/retention/recovery drills have exact evidence and no invented legal guarantees.

tasks.title: Measure real educational, editorial and commercial outcomes
tasks.target: Dashboards use defined deduplicated facts: final assessment evidence, actual learning progress, editorial review throughput and reconciled EGP payment/refund totals.
steps: Backend: publish versioned metric definitions and event schemas; derive payment facts only from ledger, learning from finalized attempts/progress, editorial from revision decisions.
Frontend: show metric period/timezone/as-of, exclusions, pending grades and source; no invented revenue or watch-time-equals-mastery claims.
Database: aggregate projections keyed by event/grade/revision version, outbox offset and reconciliation checkpoints; retain raw authoritative rows under approved retention.
Configuration/infrastructure: bounded daily incremental jobs + full rebuild comparison, late events/refunds/regrades handled, privacy cohort suppression and role-based dashboard scopes.
tasks.example: Metric={"name":"net_collected_minor","definitionVersion":1,"currency":"EGP","period":{"from":"...","to":"...","timeZone":"Africa/Cairo"},"value":150000,"asOf":"..."}; editorial median review duration from submittedAt to exact decision.
tasks.controls: Teacher only own/assigned cohorts and approved financial scope; admin aggregates, students own progress. Suppress small cohorts per approved policy, never expose student answers in telemetry. Duplicate/reordered events recompute one fact per source/version.
tasks.migration: Do not migrate fabricated historical estimates as real facts. Rebuild from ledger/grades/revisions, label unavailable periods explicitly and reconcile counts to sources. Rollback hides incorrect dashboard while preserving source data.
tests: Payments/refunds, duplicate events, grade pending/regrade, revision rejection/republication and multiple grant overlap produce expected metrics.
Cross-teacher/student scope and small-cohort privacy restrictions enforced at API.
Restart/rebuild matches incremental projection; Arabic/English Cairo period/EGP/date labels clear and no statistical overclaims.
done: Every displayed metric links to a versioned definition and source reconciliation.
No AI-production cost/generation metric remains in active product requirements.

acceptanceCases.criterion: Clean lockfile install, Prisma generation, supported runtime typechecks and both production builds pass.
Raw local/cloud private paths deny access; authorized short-lived grants/proxy work for lessons, own submissions and receipts. Offline packs remain M4 and rights-gated.
Disguised HTML/JS, invalid signatures and unsafe polyglots are rejected/quarantined and cannot execute on the application origin.
All public catalog/section/collection responses use allowlisted metadata; no paid body, object key, block secret or private visibility leakage.
Every question type is checked recursively for key/snapshot leaks on public/student/unrelated-teacher and terminal attempt paths; owner/reviewer access is explicit.
Production reference seed cannot create/reset known privileged credentials; one-time provisioning and deployed-credential remediation are evidenced.
Authenticated actor cannot be overridden on announcement/live mutations; owner and acting editor are recorded separately.
Every security-sensitive account mutation revokes stale authorization on the next request across API instances.
PENDING/REJECTED teachers cannot obtain normal sessions through login, refresh or MFA; an appeal/status path does not grant platform privileges.
Refresh has one successor, bounded 409 tab-race handling and family-scoped replay revocation; concurrent TOTP/recovery code accepts once.
Every grant source produces equivalent learning/media/assessment/assignment/discussion/download decisions and deduplicated effective audience.
Future/expired/revoked grants obey exact interval boundaries; renewal ignores stale ACTIVE labels; archive retains prior access and retraction blocks delivery.
Clamped calendar terms and explicit durations obey documented Cairo gap/overlap rules; original purchased history is not silently recalculated.
Launch provider APIs fail FEATURE_DISABLED. M4 each provider independently passes official sandbox checkout/callback/refund/reconciliation fixtures before enablement.
Manual decisions and later verified callbacks dedupe payment/grant effects, retain ledger history and reject stale payment after cancellation/refund.
Actor/operation/key and payload hash prevent disclosure, changed-intent reuse and duplicate concurrent checkout creation.
Same-student voucher race consumes one use/grant; global caps and rollback remain correct under real database concurrency.
Valid EGP resource/duration snapshots produce usable access; paid-but-unfulfilled states are durable, visible and recoverable.
Teacher changes create drafts; only exact reviewed immutable revisions publish; admin-owned publication still runs completeness.
Every launch-supported uploaded/edited block renders in order; board/code blocks show honest server-disabled state until their separate M4 gates pass.
Canonical module migration loses no lesson ID, order, preview or progress; database forbids orphan/conflicting cross-course parents.
Explicit published previews are read-only per lesson for permitted audiences; siblings, files and write operations stay protected.
Expiry persists after the HTTP error, counts once, repeats stably and permits a next attempt only within rules.
Reload uses same server deadline/saved answers; stale response or identity/quiz switch cannot leak state; expired first render is safe.
Immutable versions freeze question identities/rules; due dates and max attempts hold under concurrent submissions.
Objective types use explicit policies, essays await human rubric review, pending work is excluded from final averages/mastery/certification.
Assignment attempt/deadline/file/grader ownership and score bounds persist through concurrent HTTP/upload/browser flows.
Bounded idempotent watch progress and resume survive refresh/device change; failed sync is visible and never equated with mastery.
Uploaded supported source media is verified/processed privately, plays/seeks on target browsers and handles ranges/disconnects without crashes.
Owned-course announcements reach one effective deduplicated audience through durable delivery and bounded retry.
Valid existing teacher-provided meeting URLs are stored and presented across all eligible subjects; no invented meetings or student host-link leaks.
Entire Arabic/English interface journey works after reload; courses declare supplied AR/EN/BILINGUAL content without requiring generated translations.
Real reverse-proxy cookies/login/refresh/profile/logout/recovery work across tabs with terminal versus retryable failures distinguished.
Uploaded sources retain checksum, edition/year/term/outcome/page metadata and uploader permission declaration; no extraction/generation or automatic publication is required.
Uploader-created Arabic/English text, keys and rubrics validate, preview and atomically import/edit as drafts; exact admin approval precedes teacher publication.
Tutor UI/routes/SDK/config/fallback are removed; legacy endpoint returns 410/404 and no provider request occurs. Entitled content search is a separate staged feature, not tutoring.
Uploaded source video/audio and uploader-provided captions/transcripts retain integrity and exact revision pairing; technical transcodes/thumbnails do not generate teaching material.
DB/storage/queue/email/payment outages return correct pending/unavailable states, fail readiness appropriately and retain audit/delivery jobs; model/provider dependency is withdrawn.
Upgrade plus backup/restore preserves purchases, permissions, student work, immutable revisions and provenance; deletion ledger is respected after restore.
Dependency exposure is triaged/remediated for the release deployment; critical browser/concurrency/migration jobs have no skips; unsafe execution and incomplete integrations remain API-disabled.
Configured stages/grades/terms and Arabic/English search/paging find known courses past 100; /careers is used only where relevant; entitled full-content search remains staged.
Keyboard/screen-reader/contrast/captions/mobile/touch/slow-network flows pass; advanced features need equivalent evidence before M4 enablement.
